notes: The 'the' of 'the city of palm trees' is read as fronted from the article on תְּמָרִים (rule 29); the competing reading would supply it on the construct עִיר and leave the article unrepresented, but the rectum is rendered with no determiner of its own, which is what forces fronting.
'of the valley' is rule 33's supplied preposition on an appositional nominal standing in apposition to 'the Plain', with the supplied 'the' on the construct noun under rules 15 and 29.
'of palm trees' heads on 'palm' by rule 31, which names תִּמֹרָה → palm trees explicitly.
